author: Joseph
text:
Update Open API Room Type Naming Logic to Use a Single Room Type Name per Room Type Code
**Title**  
Update Open API Room Type Naming Logic to Use a Single Room Type Name per Room Type Code

---

## Description

Update the **Open API** Room Type naming logic to ensure each **Room Type Code** is associated with **only one standardized Room Type Name**.

Currently, the Open API appends suffixes such as **"Single Use"** to Room Type Names. This causes compatibility issues with channel partners, particularly **Dida**, whose room mapping logic relies on **Room Type Name** instead of **Room Type ID**.

Because the same Room Type ID may be returned with different Room Type Names (e.g., with and without the "Single Use" suffix), Dida treats them as different room types, resulting in mapping failures.

To improve compatibility, the Open API should always return a consistent Room Type Name for the same Room Type Code and remove the "Single Use" suffix from the Room Type Name. Single-use occupancy information should be determined using other fields (e.g., Rate Plan Name or occupancy attributes), rather than by modifying the Room Type Name.

---

## Objective

* Standardize Room Type Name for each Room Type Code
* Remove the "Single Use" suffix from Room Type Names
* Improve compatibility with channel partners that map by Room Type Name
* Prevent duplicate or failed room mappings

---

## Scope

### In Scope

* Review the current Room Type naming logic in the Open API
* Remove the "Single Use" suffix from Room Type Names
* Ensure one Room Type Code always returns one Room Type Name
* Verify downstream compatibility with existing channel integrations
* Validate that single-use information is still available through appropriate fields

### Out of Scope

* Changes to Room Type IDs
* Channel-specific mapping logic
* Rate Plan business logic

---

## Business Background

Current behavior:

* One Room Type Code may return multiple Room Type Names
* Example:

    * Deluxe Room
    * Deluxe Room - Single Use
    

Expected behavior:

* One Room Type Code → One standardized Room Type Name
* Example:

    * Deluxe Room
    

Single-use occupancy should be identified through Rate Plan information or other dedicated fields instead of the Room Type Name.

---

## Acceptance Criteria

**AC1**  
Each Room Type Code returns only one standardized Room Type Name

**AC2**  
The "Single Use" suffix is removed from Open API Room Type Names

**AC3**  
Existing room mapping remains functional for supported channels

**AC4**  
Single-use occupancy information remains available through the appropriate API fields

**AC5**  
Regression testing completed for all affected Open API endpoints

---

## Definition of Done

* Room Type naming logic updated
* "Single Use" suffix removed
* API responses validated
* Channel compatibility verified
* Documentation updated

text:
[DEV] Test inbound CMS/PMS push-data APIs on web-api to verify inventory/rate/allotment ingestion
## Glossary / Context

* HotelCmsRoutes = bean `hotelCmsRoutes` in web-api (HotelCmsRouter.java) — the inbound HTTP endpoints that external CMS/PMS partners call to push ARI data INTO web-api (port 6400).
* ARI = Availability / Rate / Inventory.
* This sub-task covers the INBOUND push side (CMS/PMS -> web-api), which is the upstream trigger that feeds the outbound push-data mechanism under parent ELS-2213 (web-api/trigger-api -> channel-dispatch -> google-meta-search).
* Scope = PUSH data endpoints only. EXCLUDED: all DAOL endpoints and all booking endpoints (confirmBooking, confirmReservation, getbooking, reservations).

## Scope — 7 inbound PUSH APIs to test

| # | Vendor | Method | Path | Data | Auth | compCode |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Sanha (산하) | POST | /WebService/AvailabilityAndRates | rate/price | IP-based | 840003 |
| 2 | HotelLink | POST | /supplier/v1/notifyAllotmentPrices | allotment+price | none + downtime gate | 840004 |
| 3 | HotelStory | POST | /v1/api/dynamic/push-available | availability | authId/authKey (body) | 840007 |
| 4 | SiteMinder | POST | /v1/api/notify/inventory-rate | inventory+rate | none (validate) | 840008 |
| 5 | D-Edge | POST | /planningUpdates | inventory+rate | domain whitelist | 840009 |
| 6 | TL Lincoln | POST | /api/tl-push/dynamic | inventory/price | none (body-routed) | 840001 |
| 7 | Neppan | POST | /neppan/ota | data in/out | none | 840006 (code) — confirm vs 840007 |

## Technical Approach

* Router: web-api/src/main/java/com/ohmy/api/router/hotel/HotelCmsRouter.java (bean hotelCmsRoutes)
* Handler: com/ohmy/api/handler/hotel/HotelCmsHandler.java; services: HotelSanhaService.updateRatePlanPriceV2, HotelHotellinkService.allotmentNotification, HotelHotelStoryService.pushAvailable, HotelSiteMinderService.pushInventoryAndRate, HotelDEdgeService.pushInventoryAndRate, HotelTlLincolnService.receiveInventory/receiveDailyRate, HotelNeppanService.handleDataAsync.
* Per-endpoint + shared QA checklist (happy path, validation fail, auth fail, malformed body, DB write correctness, idempotency, date/number boundaries, encoding, concurrency, vendor_transaction_log assertions) is documented in HotelCmsRoutes-QA-Checklist.md.
* Ready-to-import Postman collection (7 push requests, baseUrl + per-vendor credential variables) is in HotelCmsRoutes.postman_collection.json.
* Regression focus: TL Lincoln must NOT block the Netty event loop (ELS-1980 — Mono.defer + boundedElastic for @Transactional JDBC).

## Constraints / Non-goals

* Test/verification only — NO production code changes, NO DB schema changes, NO vendor contract changes.
* Do NOT cover DAOL endpoints or any booking endpoints in this sub-task.
* Confirm Neppan vendor comp code (code = NeppanHotelConfig.COMP_CODE = 840006; reported as 840007) before asserting log values — do not change the constant as part of this test task.
* Neppan router has a "정지 2024-07-14" comment but the route is active and in use — treat as active.

## Attachments (to be added manually)

* HotelCmsRoutes-QA-Checklist.md — per-API QA checklist
* HotelCmsRoutes.postman_collection.json — importable Postman collection (7 push APIs)

## Definition of Done

author: Tom
text:
Fix Web API Freeze During Hotel Mapping Search
## Goal

Fix the Web API freeze on repeated **Hotel Code Mapping** searches (root cause in ELS-2311) and make the search fast enough for normal use, without changing the returned data.

## Endpoint / files

* BE: `POST /admin/hotel/code-mapping` — `AdminHotelCodeMappingService` + `AdminHotelCodeMappingMapper.xml` (oh-api)
* FE: Hotel Code Mapping search page (oh-admin)

## Changes

1. Eliminate the per-row `NOT EXISTS (FROM VM ...)` CTE re-execution (compute the boolean once).
2. Remove `COUNT(*) OVER()`; split into separate data + count queries.
3. Replace N! word-permutation REGEXP with order-independent AND-of-LIKE.
4. Add per-statement timeout + slow-query logging; lower `connection-timeout` (fail fast).
5. Deterministic paging tie-breaker; server-side page-size clamp.
6. Thin-key pagination fast path for large countries.
7. FE: disable the Search button while a request is in flight.

## Acceptance

* No freeze under repeated/concurrent searches; first page returns in seconds.
* Returned data is **identical** to before (verified by row-count + full-result MD5 parity).

Detailed results in the fix report comment. Branch: `ELS-2306-fix-hotel-mapping-search-hang` (oh-api + oh-admin).

author: Tom
text:
Investigate and Reproduce Web API Freeze During Hotel Mapping Search
## Goal

Reproduce the staging Web API hang triggered by repeated **Hotel Code Mapping** searches, capture the exact request pattern, and identify the root cause.

## Scope

* Endpoint: `POST /admin/hotel/code-mapping` (web-api `AdminHotelCodeMappingService.getCodeMapping`)
* Reproduce by issuing the search 3+ times consecutively on staging (`test-admapi.ohmyhotel.com`).
* Measure DB query cost, connection-pool behavior, and thread usage.
* Determine whether the cause is application logic, slow SQL, pool exhaustion, or infrastructure.

## Outcome

Root cause identified and documented (see investigation report comment). The fix is tracked in **ELS-2312**.

author: Tom
text:
Optimize Hotel Mapping
## Summary

Investigate an issue where performing the **Hotel Mapping search three consecutive times** causes the **Web API on the staging environment to become unresponsive**.

The application remains stuck for an extended period, and **no relevant application logs are generated**, making the root cause difficult to identify.

---

## Description

When users repeatedly perform Hotel Mapping searches (approximately three consecutive requests), the staging Web API becomes unresponsive.

Observed behavior:

* The Web API hangs after several search requests.
* The staging environment becomes unavailable for a period of time.
* No exception or error logs are generated.
* The service eventually recovers or requires manual intervention.

This issue needs to be investigated to determine whether it is caused by application logic, database blocking, thread starvation, deadlock, resource exhaustion, or infrastructure issues.

text:
Product List - Price filter with min = max (lowest/highest bound) returns 0 hotels instead of the boundary hotel
Environment: DEV/STG/PROD — Language EN, Currency USD

Component: B2C PC and MOweb > Product List > Filter by > Price range

Pre-condition: Search Destination = Ho Chi Minh City, Check-in/out set, click Search (range shows USD 4.00 \~ 458.00)

Steps to Reproduce:

**Case 1 — min = max at the LOWEST bound**

1. In Price range, set both min and max = 4.00 (by typing, or by dragging both slider handles to the leftmost).
2. Click Apply.

Expected: at least 1 hotel is shown (the cheapest hotel, at the minimum price).

Actual: 

* PC: 0 hotels found → "No search results found. Please change your search criteria or filters."

**Case 2 — min = max at the HIGHEST bound**

1. In Price range, set both min and max = 290.00 (typing, or dragging both handles to the rightmost).
2. Click Apply.

Expected: at least 1 hotel is shown (the most expensive hotel, at the maximum price).

Actual: 0 hotels found.

* PC

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=4fdaeeea-8ebd-4b76-b2d1-644106f92f30&&collection=&height=766&occurrenceKey=null&width=1081&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
